title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PermissionSpecificationSet
description: A PermissionSpecificationSet defines a set of permissions that can be attached to a party role specification. The resulting permissions will then apply to all users that adopt this party role. (TM Forum TMF672 User Role Permission Management API 5.1.0, OpenAPI component PermissionSpecificationSet; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PermissionSpecificationSet:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PermissionSpecificationSet'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'PermissionSpecificationSet' or a sub-class / extension name.
